qualification:
Check exact original SDK versus real-guard references, not shadow guards.
The two calls start at the same account state; the actual guard is observed
and dropped before the reference call, then all live-result bits/counters,
errors and final drop effects are compared. Counter-only write frame enforced.
domain: Same10MiB storage/every view length, all bytes/metadata, all signed data/lamport borrow flags, all nonzero usize Rc headers. Original registry SDK, no SDK annotations/patches. Complete live std guard representation and exact status/counter/drop effects checked; both calls have counter-only frame.
remaining: Must pass all properties and tie exact model-source hash/registry versions to enclosing caller. ABI/compiler-specific source-helper equivalence is not general runtime heap or whole-S2 closure.
